paragraphs.source_en: “As you know, Mr. Vice President, there are a couple of ways to roll sales training out to your salespeople. One approach is to hire a motivational speaker, someone who will come in and tell stories and funny anecdotes in the hopes of energizing your sales teams. The problem is, if your salespeople return to their desks and gravitate back to the same old habits, they are likely to get the same results—as hype tends to wear off relatively quickly (A). “Another approach to training is to implement a sales process that requires sellers to fill out massive spreadsheets that document every nuance in their accounts. While reporting is important, just because you give a salesperson a blank spreadsheet to fill, doesn’t mean their prospects and customers will want to share information with them (A).
